create_RPNPostProcessor: create an RPNPostProcessor instance with pre_nms_top_n, post_nms_top_n, nms_thresh, and min_size parameters
run_RPNPostProcessor_forward: run the RPNPostProcessor forward method on anchors, objectness, and box_regression tensors to get post-processed proposals
run_RPNPostProcessor_forward_for_single_: run forward_for_single_feature_map to process anchors, objectness, and box_regression for a single FPN level
run_RPNPostProcessor_add_gt_proposals: run add_gt_proposals to append ground-truth bounding boxes to the list of RPN proposals during training
run_make_rpn_postprocessor: run make_rpn_postprocessor to construct an RPNPostProcessor from a config object and box coder
